project_type: Next.js 15.5.2 static export SPA with Cloudflare Pages Functions for API routes
build_system: pnpm 10.28.1, Next.js static export to out/, Cloudflare Pages Functions in functions/
test_framework: No tests exist yet. Steering files specify Vitest for unit tests. No vitest dependency installed.
build_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/ClassAid && pnpm run build
test_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/ClassAid && pnpm run typecheck
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm run typecheck (must pass with zero errors). 2. pnpm run build (static export must succeed producing out/ directory). 3. ESLint warning about core-web-vitals import is pre-existing and non-blocking.
setup_instructions: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/ClassAid && corepack enable && pnpm install
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22.23.2 via nvm. pnpm 10.28.1 via corepack. No Docker daemon confirmed yet. workerd build scripts ignored (pnpm approve-builds not run). ESLint config has pre-existing import issue with eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals (non-blocking).
contribution_requirements: AI-DLC methodology: plan first, implement after validation. Steering files enforce: browser calls only Pages Functions, secrets server-side only, scoring deterministic (AI cannot affect), static export, must work in fallback mode without Groq/Supabase.
key_patterns: Frontend: React Context in providers.tsx for state, localStorage via persistence.ts for fallback. API: Cloudflare Pages Functions (onRequestPost/onRequestGet patterns) in functions/api/. Currently uses D1Database, R2Bucket, Ai, VectorizeIndex bindings. Domain types in src/lib/domain/types.ts. Readiness engine in src/lib/engine/readiness-engine.ts (pure deterministic scoring). Seed data in src/lib/data/seed.ts provides demo module with fallback when APIs unavailable.
directory_structure: Root: Next.js app with static export. src/app/page.tsx is single-page entry. src/components/{learner,instructor,admin}/ for role-based UI. src/lib/ for domain logic, data, engine. functions/api/ for Cloudflare Pages Functions (7 routes). migrations/ for D1 schema (needs Supabase conversion). public/ for static assets (slides.html, guide.html).
